BiblicalUsage: Bilgai means my cheerfulness, and he is named once, among the priests who sealed the covenant. Nehemiah 10:8 lists him with Maaziah and Shemaiah: these were the priests. One verse, one name on a sealed promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a signature on the covenant is an act of faith, and Bilgai's is one of the quiet ones.
